title: Bedrock Breaker
description: Just add new item to break the bedrock a roof of the nether.
body:
[![OTHER PROJECTS](https://img.shields.io/badge/DATAPACK%20ONLY-00af5c?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=gray)](https://modrinth.com/user/Kyrianow) [![DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/MORE%20HELP/BUG%20OR%20OTHERS-5865f2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&labelColor=gray)](https://discord.gg/qabbadeptc) # Bedrock Breaker I created the datapack "Bedrock Breaker" to simplify the fact of breaking the bedrock roof of the nether :
- The "Little Bedrock breaker" will break you a 1 by 1 area with all the depth bedrocks. - The "Middle Bedrock breaker" is like the Small but makes an area of 3 by 3. - The "Large Bedrock breaker" is like the Small but makes an area of 5 by 5. ## Craft For the crafts you will find them in games in the Recipe Book and in the **[gallery modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bedrock-breaker/gallery)**. ## How to update Simply **delete** the **Bedrockbreaker.zip** and **replace** it with the **new** one!
